question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Jovial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"jovial"** means cheerful and friendly. (प्रसन्नचित्त)

 
 
• **Example: **He was in a jovial mood after hearing the good news.
 
 
 
• **"Cheerful" **refers to being noticeably happy and optimistic. (उत्साही)
 
 
• **Example: **Her cheerful demeanor brightened up the whole room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym of **'jovial' **is **'cheerful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Miserable **(दुःखी): Feeling very unhappy or uncomfortable.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt miserable after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Solemnity **(गंभीरता ): The state or quality of being serious and dignified.
 
 
• **Example: **The solemnity of the occasion was felt by all attendees.
 
 
 
• **Profane** (अपवित्र): Relating to or involving something that is not sacred or biblical; secular rather than religious.
 
 
• **Example:** His profane language offended many people.
